comparison.objective: Candidate removes a connector terminal; record sharpens a pencil with a crank sharpener and returns it to a rest.
comparison.physical_skill: Latch depression and same-direction wire/tool extraction versus coaxial pencil insertion with sustained axial contact while cranking.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires selective intact extraction but lacks numeric force/damage limits. Record scores accumulated cut depth only under valid insertion/cranking contact, then pencil removal, rest placement, and release.
comparison.reason: The record tests rotary material removal and maintained feed; the candidate tests latch release.
